name: Igor Nazarov
abstract_title: Radical Embodiment: Systemic Bio-Modulation and Neural Re-Mapping in Soviet Extrasensory Research
abstract: This abstract utilizes unique, formerly classified, Soviet experimental data (1960s–1980s) to hypothesize that certain Extra-Sensory Perception (ESP) phenomena represent a highly specialized, metabolically costly, and trainable form of Radical Embodied Cognition. notes: Research connects Schumann resonance to brain wave states.
